output.title: Cat on Red Carpet
output.description: A calico cat with white and brown fur lies stretched out on a bright red carpet. Its eyes are closed, and its paws are relaxed, suggesting it is resting or sleeping. Behind the cat is a dark, draped fabric. In the blurred background, architectural elements and a potted plant are visible. No readable text is present.
output.summary: A calico cat rests peacefully on a red carpet.

output.title: Paris Eiffel Tower Night
output.description: A panoramic view of Paris at dusk, featuring the illuminated Eiffel Tower on the left and a row of modern high-rise buildings along the riverbank. The Seine River reflects the city lights, with several boats moored along the embankment. Trees line the waterfront, and streetlights cast a warm glow. The sky is a deep twilight blue.
output.summary: Nighttime Paris skyline with the Eiffel Tower and riverfront buildings reflected in the Seine.

output.title: Two Players in Action
output.description: Two female soccer players compete for the ball on a green field. One in a white jersey with number 17 and the name 'Mareu' on the back is defending. The other, in a dark blue jersey, is advancing. A soccer ball is airborne near them. In the background, stadium seats are empty, and a blue banner reads 'RÉVONS PLUS GRAND'.
output.summary: Two female soccer players contest a ball during a match in an empty stadium.

output.title: Data Collection Sign
output.description: A clear acrylic plaque mounted on a textured wall displays a warning about data collection. The text reads: 'Data is collected on everything we do.*' followed by '*Do you know how yours is being used?'. Faint, ghosted copies of the text are visible behind the main message. The plaque is held by four metallic fasteners.
output.summary: A warning sign about data collection mounted on a wall.

output.title: Wooden Guitar on Couch
output.description: A classical guitar with a light wood finish stands upright on a gray couch. The instrument has a glossy surface, six strings, and a dark fretboard. Behind it, a plain white wall features a wooden-framed picture. The couch has dark and light gray pillows.
output.summary: A classical guitar rests on a gray couch against a white wall.

output.title: C# Code Editor
output.description: A dark-themed code editor window displays C# source code. The code declares a string array with two cat names, 'Barsik' and 'Murka', and uses a foreach loop to print 'Feed {cat}' for each. The editor title bar reads 'Program.cs - Editor'.
output.summary: C# code in a dark editor window loops through cat names to print a message.

output.title: Handwritten To-Do List
output.description: A light green sticky note with handwritten Russian text. The note lists tasks: 'Buy milk and bread.' 'Call grandma!' Signed 'To Celia, Lena.' The handwriting is in a casual cursive style.
output.summary: A handwritten note with grocery and phone tasks in Russian.

output.title: Dragonfly Close Up
output.description: A macro shot captures a dragonfly's face in detail. Its large, compound eyes and prominent mouthparts are visible. A small, pale insect lies beneath its legs on a textured surface. The background is softly blurred, emphasizing the insect's features.
output.summary: A macro photograph of a dragonfly's face with a small insect nearby.

output.title: black and white cat sleeping
output.description: A black and white cat is curled up and sleeping on a gray concrete surface. The cat's body is compact, with white paws and a white patch on its chest. The concrete has a rough, textured surface with visible wear. No readable text is present in the image.
output.summary: A black and white cat sleeps curled on concrete.

output.title: duck in green water
output.description: A duck with a dark head and reddish neck is swimming away from the camera in murky green water. The water reflects the surrounding stone walls and floating leaves. The duck's body is mostly submerged, with only its head and shoulders visible above the surface.
output.summary: A duck swims away in murky green water near stone walls.
